mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (current value) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 5-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 5-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (more than 0.5 percentage points over the past three months) signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE falls > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) and high retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between UNRATE and RSAFS is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 20-day returns on the interaction term, or the Rank IC for the joint signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising federal funds rate), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, with the effect being most pronounced over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (current value) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 5-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between RSAFS and 5-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (more than 1.0% over the past three months) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high industrial production (INDPRO) and high housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic activity across manufacturing and construction sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between INDPRO and HOUST is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 20-day returns on the interaction term, or the Rank IC for the joint signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (characterized by high GDP growth and low unemployment), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to overvaluation and reduced earnings growth momentum, with the effect being most pronounced over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
